title: 并购回暖：年终奖最高涨三成，交易员成最大赢家？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: First joining us to break down the study is Bloomberg Finance reporter, Catherine Doherty.
segments.zh: 首先，我们邀请彭博财经记者凯瑟琳·多尔蒂来解读这份报告。

segments.en: Um, Kato, I mean, these guys work hard. They probably deserve that 10 to 15 percent paper.
segments.zh: 凯托，这些人工作很努力，他们可能值得那10%到15%的奖金。

segments.en: I'm just giving how crazy things have been on Wall Street. Yeah, it's been super active and we haven't seen it pull back in any way.
segments.zh: 我只是在说华尔街有多疯狂。是的，市场非常活跃，我们还没有看到任何回落。

segments.en: So as you pointed out, the traders are projected to see the biggest payouts.
segments.zh: 正如你指出的，交易员预计将获得最大的回报。

segments.en: Some more than 30 percent investment bankers, though.
segments.zh: 有些甚至超过30%，不过**银行家也有。

segments.en: I think that's the story to highlight this year. We've seen a resurgence of M&A deals have come back in a way that we haven't seen.
segments.zh: 我认为这是今年值得关注的重点。我们看到并购交易重新活跃，这是前所未有的。

segments.en: And we've been expecting for a few years now, but now we're actually starting to see the IPO pipeline and some of the other M&A activity come through.
segments.zh: 我们已经期待了几年，但现在我们真的开始看到IPO管道和其他并购活动出现。

segments.en: So you're expected to see that reflected in end of your bonuses.
segments.zh: 所以你预计这会反映在年终奖金中。

segments.en: There are a lot of caveats to this report. We still have the remainder of 2026 to get through.
segments.zh: 这份报告有很多注意事项。我们还有2026年的剩余时间要度过。

segments.en: So we could see a big pullback and the markets could change.
segments.zh: 所以我们可能会看到大幅回落，市场可能会发生变化。

segments.en: But right now, all things are indicating that the end of this year is looking pretty good across the board.
segments.zh: 但目前所有迹象都表明，今年年底整体形势相当不错。

segments.en: You've got to wonder what oil traders are feeling like in terms of their bonuses this year.
segments.zh: 你可能会好奇，今年石油交易员的奖金会是什么情况。

segments.en: I wonder, the part about AI eliminating jobs and that makes sense that the higher paid are going to get more for it.
segments.zh: 我想，关于AI取代工作这一点，高薪者可能会因此获得更多。

segments.en: But what about the lower paid levels who are still around?
segments.zh: 但那些仍然在职的低薪阶层呢？

segments.en: Are you going to get people cheaper because there aren't that many jobs?
segments.zh: 因为工作机会不多，你会不会以更低的成本雇到人？
